# usectl

> **One flat price. No bandwidth bills.**
>
> usectl is a managed deployment platform. Create a machine, get a full stack inside on one flat monthly bill: managed PostgreSQL, S3-compatible object storage, Redis, cron jobs, PR previews, custom domains, unlimited team seats. No bandwidth metering. No per-build charges. No seat pricing.
>
> **Primary interface:** CLI (single binary, `--json` output, Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf can drive it out of the box). MCP server available for tighter AI integration.
>
> **Substrate:** Our own bare metal at Hetzner. K3s + Kaniko + CloudNativePG + SeaweedFS + Traefik. We own the hardware, not AWS or Google Cloud, which is why the pricing is flat.
>
> **Built for:** AI-assisted developers and small engineering teams. Not vibecoders. Not AWS-native enterprise.

## Documentation

Full documentation is available at https://docs.usectl.com/llms-full.txt
